headline: NZ's Rachin Ravindra dislocated shoulder during commercial shoot, doubt for India series
summary: The all-rounder suffered a 'freak accident' while filming a promotional event, leaving his participation in the upcoming T20 series against India uncertain.
details: New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra is in doubt for the upcoming home series against India after suffering a shoulder dislocation during a commercial shoot on Wednesday.
The injury occurred during a promotional event involving the host broadcaster, where Ravindra landed awkwardly on a safety mat while attempting a diving catch.
New Zealand Cricket announced that while the player has been cleared of major structural damage, it remains unclear if he will play in the five-match T20 series starting October 22.
The injury comes at a critical time, as the New Zealand team is preparing for a series of five ODIs and two Tests against India, followed by a four-Test series in Australia.
Performance manager Mike Sandle stated that the activities were agreed upon in advance with safety measures in place, describing the incident as a 'freak accident'.
Coach Rob Walter emphasized that Ravindra's rehabilitation will be carefully managed to avoid rushing him back, given the heavy Test cricket schedule over the next six months.
caption:
A diving catch for a commercial shoot ended in a 'freak accident' for Rachin Ravindra.

New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra is in doubt for the upcoming home series against India after suffering a shoulder dislocation during a commercial shoot on Wednesday.

The injury occurred during a promotional event involving the host broadcaster, where Ravindra landed awkwardly on a safety mat while attempting a diving catch.

New Zealand Cricket announced that while the player has been cleared of major structural damage, it remains unclear if he will play in the five-match T20 series starting October 22.

The injury comes at a critical time, as the New Zealand team is preparing for a series of five ODIs and two Tests against India, followed by a four-Test series in Australia.

Performance manager Mike Sandle stated that the activities were agreed upon in advance with safety measures in place, describing the incident as a 'freak accident'.

Coach Rob Walter emphasized that Ravindra's rehabilitation will be carefully managed to avoid rushing him back, given the heavy Test cricket schedule over the next six months.

headline_marked: Gold prices rise by ৳1,691 per bhori: [[Gold prices increase again]] in Bangladesh
headline: Gold prices rise by ৳1,691 per bhori: Gold prices increase again in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has adjusted prices due to rising costs in the local and global markets.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have increased by ৳1,691 per bhori, effective from Saturday morning at 10 AM.
The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) stated that the price adjustment was necessary due to rising costs of fine gold in the local market and trends in the global market.
Following the hike, 22-carat gold is now priced at ৳234,621 per bhori, while 21-carat gold is ৳224,065, and 18-carat gold is ৳192,398.
Traditional gold is now priced at ৳157,172 per bhori. Before this increase, 22-carat gold was priced at ৳232,930.
Silver prices have also risen by ৳116 per bhori, bringing the price of 22-carat silver to ৳5,132 per bhori.
Gold prices have seen significant volatility recently, reaching a historic high of ৳286,000 per bhori on January 29 this year.
According to GoldPrice.org, global gold prices have fluctuated, dropping $17 per ounce on Friday and decreasing by $153 over the last 30 days.
caption:
Gold prices are up again! ৳1,691 increase per bhori starting today.

Gold prices in Bangladesh have increased by ৳1,691 per bhori, effective from Saturday morning at 10 AM.

The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) stated that the price adjustment was necessary due to rising costs of fine gold in the local market and trends in the global market.

Following the hike, 22-carat gold is now priced at ৳234,621 per bhori, while 21-carat gold is ৳224,065, and 18-carat gold is ৳192,398.

Traditional gold is now priced at ৳157,172 per bhori. Before this increase, 22-carat gold was priced at ৳232,930.

Silver prices have also risen by ৳116 per bhori, bringing the price of 22-carat silver to ৳5,132 per bhori.

Gold prices have seen significant volatility recently, reaching a historic high of ৳286,000 per bhori on January 29 this year.

According to GoldPrice.org, global gold prices have fluctuated, dropping $17 per ounce on Friday and decreasing by $153 over the last 30 days.
